children.value: te sametya gṛhaṃ gatvā rājaputrāḥ śaśitviṣaḥ
vyatīyāya śanaiḥ śyāmā muhūrta iva śobhanā
bhūtāni ca vicitrāṇi kimāyānti prayānti kiṃ
māyeyaṃ sā kimutthā syātkathaṃ caiva nivartate
nivṛttayānayā kaḥ syādguṇo doṣo'tha vā bhavet
bhogāstyaktuṃ na śakyante tattyāgena vinā vayam
pade surūḍhaṃ viśramya bhramiṣyāmi kadā jagat
ayaṃ so'haṃ rudanmūḍha iti vyarthāhito bhramaḥ
kaccitpadaṃ tvayi manaḥ kariṣyantīti me vada
hā tāta mātaḥ putreti girāmāsāmahaṃ punaḥ
he buddhe bhagini bhrāturarthitāṃ pūrayāśu me
tvāṃ pādapatitaḥ prītyā yāce sati sute mate

kṛtamati śataśo vicāritaṃ ya-
dyadi tadupaiti na mānasasya buddhiḥ

bhavati tadaphalaṃ śaradghanābhaṃ
satatamato matireva kāryasāraḥ
